[attribute-platforms]
=== `@platforms` Platforms

Name(s) of hardware and/or software platform(s) on which this code is intended to run. It is assumed that each such platform will have a one-word “name”, and multiple platform names will be separated by spaces.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-code,`<code>`>>, 
                  <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Platform on which the <<element-code,`<code>`>> is intended
                        to run, for example, “`Mac OS X`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
